page.overview:
What is Crawdaunt?

Crawdaunt is a red lobster-like Pokémon with a golden star on its forehead. It has large claws and the bottom of these claws are tan. Its feet have two claws each and it has a large tail. There is a blue stripe in the middle of its tan belly.

Crawdaunt is highly territorial and will attack anyone or anything that tries to invade its nesting grounds. Its claws tend to break apart from its arms, but the meat inside has a more repulsive aroma than Crabrawler and Clauncher's claws. Once it molts, Crawdaunt is more vulnerable to attacks and will avoid any fight by burrowing inside stream beds.

Because of its rough and dangerous nature, Crawdaunt can be very challenging to trainers who want to raise it.

Crawdaunt evolves from Corphish starting at level 30.
